task.title: Android Google sign-in bounce dead-ends: the deep-link filter is never committed
task.description:
Maintainer report (2026-08-16, release APK on phone): Google OAuth opens in the browser and completes, lands on the 'Returning to Three Rings… Open the app' bounce page — but 'Open the app' does nothing and the app stays at 'Waiting for Google'. Email/password works (post-#159).

CONFIRMED root cause (aapt2 dump of the installed APK): the release manifest contains NO three-rings:// scheme intent-filter — only MAIN/LAUNCHER + androidx profileinstaller. The committed src-tauri/gen/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml has zero mentions of the scheme. Tauri's deep-link plugin (TAURI_DEEP_LINK_PLUGIN_CONFIG carries mobile scheme 'three-rings') INJECTS the filter into the source manifest during dev runs — and this session's workers + the android-smoke skill have been treating that injection as build noise to git-checkout away. It is load-bearing: without it the bounce page's deep link is unclaimable, so the OAuth callback can never reach the app.

Fix: commit the deep-link intent-filter properly into the source manifest (VIEW action, BROWSABLE+DEFAULT categories, data scheme three-rings — match exactly what the plugin injects), with a manifest comment marking it load-bearing for the OAuth bounce; UPDATE the android-smoke skill's guidance (currently instructs reverting the injection — exactly backwards); verify the app-side deep-link handling completes the challenge (the google_sign_in Android-bounce routing exists per the #159 findings — confirm the listener wiring end to end).

Verify: rebuild the release APK; aapt2 dump shows the filter; on the emulator install the release APK and (a)  opens the app, (b) simulate the bounce page's actual callback deep-link shape (derive it from auth_pages.rs/google_sign_in) and confirm the waiting flow completes or at least consumes it; full-flow click-through remains the maintainer's phone test. Also CHECK (report only): does the release .app's Info.plist register the scheme for macOS (CFBundleURLTypes) — the desktop Google flow may share this gap.
